input.query: how to get a library card

results.response: Getting a card is free if you live, work, or go to school in the Maplewood area. Bring a photo ID and something that shows your current address (one item showing both works too). Sign up at the circulation desk of any branch, or start online and finish at a desk. Kids can get a card with a parent or guardian present to sign.

input.query: place a hold on a book

results.response: To place a hold, find the item in the online catalog, choose Place Hold, and pick your pickup branch. You'll be notified when it arrives, and it waits for you on the holds shelf for a few days. Holds are the easy way to gather items from any branch in one spot.

Install the eLibrary app, choose Maplewood Public Library, and sign in with your card number and PIN. Then just tap Borrow on any title and it downloads to your device. Titles return themselves at the end of the loan, so there's nothing to bring back.
Yes. Every branch has free public WiFi during open hours, and you don't need a library card to use it. The public computers are free too.
